info.title: Club Management API
info.description:
Multi-tenant court booking platform.

Membership packages are created and assigned by Club Admins.

Consumer package checkout is simulated only: it does not contact a payment provider or collect money.

See README.md and docs/progress-log.md for the package lifecycle.

clubSlug.description: Required for club admins and consumers. Omit for the platform admin.

closeTime.description: "24:00" means midnight at end of day

openingHours.description: Complete weekly schedule. Days not listed are closed. Repeat a day for multiple periods.

expectedPrice.description: The price the user saw. If the real price differs, the booking is rejected with 409.

shiftId.description: Shift id. Omit or send null for the Normal (default) price.

prices.description: The complete price list for the court. Anything not listed is removed.

validityDays.description: How many days a subscription lasts
How many days a subscription lasts

prices.description: The complete price list of the plan. Anything not listed is removed.

durations.description: Optional subset of the location durations. Omit (or send null on update) to offer all of them.
Optional subset of the location durations. Omit (or send null on update) to offer all of them.

useLocationHours.description: true = follow the location hours (clears custom hours)

openingHours.description: Required when useLocationHours is false. Days not listed are closed for this court.

includedBookings.description: Number of bookings included in the package.

pricePerBooking.description: Numeric rate per booking. Fee is rate multiplied by quota; display currency symbols in the client.

isActive.description: Inactive packages cannot be assigned to new consumers. Terms cannot change after assignment.

userId.description: Existing consumer registered in this club context.
